Post Date: 2018-09-04T09:41:08Z

Title: toList + blockingGet got No instance field actual of type
Description: Hello.

  -Rx java version 2.2.1

  - Sample code ```Observable.fromIterable(Collections.asList(1,2,3,4,5).map(it->String.valuesOf(it)).toList().blockinGet()```

In version 2.2.0 this code works fine, but after update i got ```No instance field actual of type Lio/reactivex/Observer; in class Lcom/tspoon/traceur/ObservableOnAssembly$OnAssemblyObserver; or its superclasses (declaration of 'com.tspoon.traceur.ObservableOnAssembly$OnAssemblyObserver' appears in /data/app/<package>-70wiK-18tepU--Vcj9Vf3A==/base.apk!classes5.dex)```

CATEGORY: [category number]

llm_response:
CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue can be analyzed without a build environment. The problem is a compatibility issue between RxJava 2.2.1 and a library called Traceur (which is implied by the error message mentioning "com.tspoon.traceur"). The error occurs because the Traceur library is likely not compatible with the updated RxJava version. The code itself has a syntax error (`String.valuesOf(it)` should be `String.valueOf(it)`), but the main issue is the library compatibility problem. This can be verified through code analysis without needing to build or run the code. The solution would likely involve either downgrading back to RxJava 2.2.0, updating the Traceur library to a version compatible with RxJava 2.2.1, or removing the Traceur dependency if it's not essential.
